mapper.select: SELECT r.STUDENT_ID AS studentId, sp.STUDENT_NO AS studentNo, sp.NAME AS studentName, DATE_FORMAT(r.READ_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS readAt FROM BIZ_STUDENT_NOTIFICATION_READ r LEFT JOIN BIZ_STUDENT_PROFILE sp ON sp.ID = r.STUDENT_ID WHERE r.NOTIFICATION_ID = #{noticeId} AND r.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' ORDER BY r.READ_AT DESC
